question: In which year was the Azad Hind Radio Service as part of Germany's radio service started?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1942**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Azad Hind Radio **

 
 
• In order to spread **anti-British propaganda**, **Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose founded the Azad Hind Radio in Berlin, Germany**.
 
• In **1942** the Azad Hind Radio Service as part of Germany's radio service was started. 
 
• The first transmission took place on **January 7, 1942**.
 
• Its headquarters were first located in **Germany**, but they were later moved to **Singapore and then Myanmar**.
 
• **A.C.N. Nambiar**, the leader of the **Indian Legion in Germany**, took over the organization's operations in Germany after Bose's passing.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The shows were broadcast in **English, Telugu, Tamil, Gujarati, Marathi, Bengali, Pushto, and Tamil**.
 
• Bose used to **declare war** on the British government on **October 23, 1942**.
 
• The radio programmes were **rebroadcast in 2009**. 
 
• On the radio, Bose referred to the **All India Radio as the "Anti-Indian Radio"** and the** British Broadcasting Corporation as the "Bluff and Bluster Corporation"** respectively.
